footerPanel.heading: Not a pitch deck. Receipts first.
footerPanel.body: The page is intentionally compact: dates, surfaces, short theme notes, and direct evidence links. It is meant to help a busy reader see that FMI work is not confined to one repo or one claim; it spans policy, software, public education, research indexing, and open technical infrastructure.
